sources.title: Wikipedia: B. B. King
sources.description: American blues guitarist, singer, and songwriter (1925–2015)

notes.text: B.B. King, was an American blues guitarist, singer, songwriter, and record producer.
B.B. King introduced a sophisticated style of soloing based on fluid string bending, shimmering vibrato, and staccato picking that influenced many later electric guitar blues players.
AllMusic recognized B.B. King as "the single most important electric guitarist of the last half of the 20th century".
B.B. King is remembered as a musician connected with United States.
B.B. King's recorded life dates place this profile around 1925-2015.
